title: Extension suggestions
description: What `aidd extensions suggest --json` prints: the stacks found in the repository, the extensions that fit them and the team's roles, and each role's toolsets. Each is a starting point a team verifies, pins, and installs through a change; aidd installs nothing.

capabilities.description: What the extension can do on the machine, such as network, writes_repo, runs_commands, reads_secrets, or telemetry.

stacks.description: The stacks the repository's manifests name, sorted.

suggestions.description: The extensions that fit the stacks and the roles, each once.

name.description: The extension's name, as the team registry lists it.

tier.description: Who stands behind it: official, vendor, maintainer, or community.

maturity.description: How proven it is, such as established or emerging.

pin.description: The version a team installs, and the commit or digest that names it.

license.description: Its license, such as MIT or Apache-2.0.

install.description: The one command that installs it, which aidd prints and never runs.

adds.description: What it adds to each role it extends, by role.

toolsets.description: Each role's named toolsets, picked by enabling their extensions in the project, never by a config key.

role.description: The role the toolset belongs to.

toolset.description: The toolset's name, such as ai-design or browser-review.

default.description: What the role uses when the project enabled none of its toolsets.

uses.description: What the role works with in this toolset, and when it passes.

extensions.description: The names of the extensions the toolset installs.

test_command.description: The Spec test command the toolset adds, when it adds one.

parts.description: Each extension of the toolset, with what a team needs to verify and pin it.

pin.description: The version to install, and what names it.

install.description: The one command that installs it, which aidd prints and never runs.

source.description: Where it comes from: its repository or its page.

telemetry_opt_out.description: True when its telemetry can be turned off.
